overlap.reason: 46.4 is OCMS sending offender ID/mobile to Payment Gateway for PayNow refund (refund direction). 52.5 sends AXS payment records to URA PG recon. Different payload, endpoint and purpose.

43.2 is payment status coming IN from the Payment Gateway and marking notices paid. 52.5 is the reverse direction (OCMS pushing AXS rows out to URA PG). Same business area (AXS/PG payments) and URA may read "report AXS payment to PG" as part of the payment feed; mitigate by stating that 52.5 only covers the outbound hourly send and does not mark notices paid.
46.5 is PayNow refund status received from the Payment Gateway for Cumulus; unrelated to AXS recon send.
